title: iso20022-mcp
description: Unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for ISO 20022. Exposes one small set of meta-tools (search, describe, validate, generate, parse) that route across the pain, pacs, camt and acmt message families, so an agent works with initiation, clearing/settlement, cash-management and account-management messages through a single consistent interface instead of one server per message type. Apache-2.0, pure Python over stdio.
